name: Public joint stock company BANK URALSIB
summary: Public Joint Stock Company BANK URALSIB, together with its subsidiaries, provides various banking products and services to individuals and corporate clients in Russia and internationally. The company operates through Corporate Banking Operations, Retail Banking Operations, Small Business, Leasing Operations, Financial services and Markets, Treasury and Asset-Liability Management Unit, and Corporate Investments and Other Operations segments. Its products and services include commercial lending and deposit taking, settlements and cash transactions, trade finance, and transactions with precious metals; and money transfer and foreign exchange services, and various banking card products. The company is also involved in primary and secondary equity and debt capital markets activities; brokerage services and securities trading, including repurchase agreements transactions and derivative transactions; and placement and raising of funds. In addition, it offers a range of banking services for high net worth individuals, including their savings management and financial advisory. Further, the company invests in and rents retail trade premises, completed residential apartments, residential buildings under construction, and land; manages properties; and provides leasing and management services. It operates through a network of 6 branches. Public Joint Stock Company BANK URALSIB was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Moscow, Russia.
